Senior Software Engineer (platform engineering) at Oportun, a financial services company, working on backend platform services and shared libraries used by other engineering teams. The work centers on reliability, scalability, and developer experience — including architecture decisions, performance and reliability debugging, monitoring and incident response, and mentoring other engineers. Core stack is backend languages like Java, C#, or C++ with containerized applications on AWS, GCP, or Azure, plus continuous delivery pipelines and distributed systems.
